title: Aggregated usage snapshot lag causing temporary over-allow for per-org quotas
creator: Ava Chen
description: Intermittent customer reports and internal alerts show short bursts of unmetered/over-allowed requests for some organizations when a shard aggregator failover occurs during high ingestion. Root cause appears to be a race where delayed aggregated-usage snapshots (async flush) are merged after a newer epoch has already advanced, leading to a merge that increases effective allowance instead of being discarded. This ticket tracks investigation, mitigation, and a long-term fix to ensure snapshot merges are monotonic and idempotent.
steps_to_reproduce: Synthetic repro harness produced in staging: spin up 3 aggregator shards with per-route pre-aggregation enabled
Start steady traffic for org O with per-route quota limits and per-key token buckets; capture baseline usage
Trigger controlled failover: force shard A to crash during its async snapshot flush window
Simultaneously pump a short burst of traffic that would normally be throttled by per-org quota
Observe allowance change on reconciliation and compare metering records vs expected allowance
observed_behavior: After failover and shard reconciliation, the org's effective allowance briefly increases permitting a >N-second burst beyond configured quota. Metering records show duplicate attribution for a subset of requests (same snapshot IDs applied twice) and an aggregate allowance delta that doesn't match token consumption.
expected_behavior: Aggregator snapshot merges should be monotonic: an incoming snapshot with an older epoch or duplicate snapshot ID should be ignored or tombstoned; merges must never increase allowance beyond summed consumptions and must be idempotent across retries/failovers.
reproduction_logs: staging-agg-1.log: 2026-03-01T14:12:03Z INFO flush-snapshot id=sn-0a3e epoch=42 bytes=12kb
staging-agg-2.log: 2026-03-01T14:12:06Z INFO reconcile merge-incoming snapshot_id=sn-0a3e epoch=42 target_epoch=43
billing-asserts.log: 2026-03-01T14:12:06Z ERROR allowance-delta org=org_123 delta=+120 tokens expected=-120
hypotheses: Async flush completes after coordinator advances epoch; reconciliation code does not properly compare snapshot epoch vs current shard epoch and applies merge that incorrectly offsets debit sums
Duplicate snapshot IDs may be replayed across shards during rebalancing and not deduped because dedupe index is ephemeral and cleared on failover

Merge logic uses max() on per-route counters which can treat late partial snapshots as additive in the wrong commutative order leading to temporary overcounting of allowance instead of respecting ledger semantics
investigation_notes: Confirmed with index dump that flush with snapshot_id sn-0a3e arrived after coordinator moved target_epoch to 43. The merge path accepted epoch=42 snapshot and applied per-route counters by summing, which led to apparent double-counting when upstream had already accounted the same tokens.
Observed that the dedupe table is in-memory and keyed by ephemeral shard-local nonce; during failover the new shard had an empty dedupe table and accepted the replayed snapshot
Telemetry: added a temporary metric aggregator.snapshot.apply_latency which showed a 4-7s tail during heavy GC spikes on aggregator nodes
Correlation: high disk I/O on aggregator nodes (compaction) led to longer async flush completion times which increased the window for a stale snapshot to be merged post-epoch-advance
short_term_mitigations: Hotfix (PR #GHT-1428): treat incoming snapshot with epoch < current_epoch as tombstone; do not merge, log and emit metric aggregator.snapshot.stale_rejected
Deploy hotfix to staging and canary w/ aggressive sampling of orgs with high usage to validate no false negatives
Backpressure: temporarily increase sync flush frequency for affected aggregators to reduce async tail (config knob runtime: aggregator.flush.tail_ns=2000000000 -> 500000000)
Run a one-time reconciliation job to detect and correct any org balances that were inflated in last 48h (see reference script in /confluence/billing/reconcile-runbook)
Customer comms: prepare note for SRE and CS for impacted customers if reconciliation is required
long_term_fixes: Make snapshot merges epoch-aware and idempotent: include snapshot_id and origin_shard in dedupe index persisted in local durable store (leveldb) to survive failovers

Change merge semantics from additive naive-sum to monotonic-merge where per-route counters are merged by taking max(local, incoming) of cumulative counts plus explicit consumed-delta logic against ledger reference
Introduce a causal vector (or per-shard monotonically increasing sequence) alongside epoch to detect and order cross-shard snapshots deterministically
Add integration tests in chaos harness that simulate failover + concurrent snapshot flushes and assert no positive allowance deltas
Add canary dashboard and alert: snapshot.apply_rejected_rate and snapshot.duplicate_detected_rate, and billing-consistency.checks per-org
decision_log: 2026-03-04: Interim decision to ship hotfix that rejects epoch-stale snapshots (PR GHT-1428). Consensus: low risk and addresses the immediate customer impact.
2026-03-08: Approve persisted dedupe index design and monotonic-merge approach. Assigned design owner: Priya Nair (platform-infra).
2026-03-10: Prioritized long-term change into runtime-1.26 milestone; estimated 3 sprints of work across aggregator and routing teams
acceptance_criteria: Hotfix merged to main and rolled to production canary with no regressions (GHT-1428 merged)
snapshot.apply_rejected_rate metric is >0 for at least one canary and no reported post-deploy over-allow incidents
Integration chaos test passes for 1000 simulated failover cycles with zero positive allowance deviation recorded
Persistent dedupe prototype merged to staging and shows <0.1% additional latency on snapshot apply path
Run reconciliation script and confirm corrected balances (if any) or assert no corrections necessary
rollout_plan: Stage: deploy hotfix to staging cluster, run synthetic harness (03/05)
Canary: deploy to 10% of production aggregator fleet with traffic shift and sampling (03/06)
Monitor metrics for 48h: snapshot.apply_rejected_rate, org_allowance_delta, billing-mismatch-alerts (03/06-03/08)
Full prod: ramp to 100% after canary green (03/09)
Begin long-term work in parallel: design doc and persisted dedupe PoC (03/11 onwards)
